in_marathi.name: Ishanika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishanika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ishanika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ishana’ meaning God and ‘Nika’ meaning rule or ruler. This name signifies the one who rules or governs God. In Hindu mythology, Ishan is a name of Shiva, the supreme deity, symbolizing the ruler of the universe.
